layer_2_correctness.mass_of_injectant: Reported 72.57 kg and CORRECT. Max settled the rule on 2026-08-10: per-weighing precision follows the scale that did the weighing, not the oil type. 2.5 lb / 1.13 kg is the precision of Charm's tote scale; 72.57 kg is the precision of a commercial truck scale. This tanker was weighed on CAT Scale weighbridges (scale 1895 Wilson Township WI; scale 1864 Port Barre LA), so the commercial-scale spec governs, as it does for an AECN tanker. One discrete weighing event, so 1 x 72.57 kg. The Kerry skill and checklist reference have been corrected to key off the scale rather than the oil type.
layer_2_correctness.mass_of_load: Same 72.57 kg, correct on the same basis.

layer_3_discount.sensitivity: Had 1.13 kg been used instead of 72.57 kg, the discount would fall to about 130 kg and net would rise to about 32.04 t. The value in place therefore under-credits by roughly 61 kg CO2e.
